episodes.name: Langley Dollar Listings
episodes.overview: Francine becomes a realtor in Langley's world of high-end real estate, while the rest of the family sells coffee from the front yard.

episodes.name: Dressed Down
episodes.overview: When Stan doesn't feel confident in anything but his suits, Roger assumes a fashion designer persona to craft him a life-changing new wardrobe. Hayley and Jeff raise chickens in the back yard.

episodes.name: The Book of Fischer
episodes.overview: Stan takes Steve to his favorite barbershop to hang with his crew; Jeff starts journaling to help with his bad memory.

episodes.name: A Roger Story
episodes.overview: Steve and Snot's friendship gets put to the test when their mothers start to fight.

episodes.name: Epic Powder Dump
episodes.overview: Stan insists everyone help him recreate the rustic family ski trips of his childhood while Klaus falls in love with a tech support operator.

episodes.name: American Dad Graffito
episodes.overview: To save a beloved restaurant from closing, Stan must bring the 1950s back to Langley.

episodes.name: Beyond the Alcove or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Klaus
episodes.overview: Francine is jealous of the new and improved Klaus and vows to take him down.

episodes.name: A Song of Knives and Fire
episodes.overview: Stan and Francine inject some much-needed fire into their relationship.

episodes.name: The Curious Case of the Old Hole
episodes.overview: Wheels and the Legman try to hunt down the perpetrators who destroyed Steve's secret swimming hole. Meanwhile, Klaus helps an aging Principal Lewis reclaim his confidence.

episodes.name: Gold Top Nuts
episodes.overview: The Smiths return from a difficult, quarrelsome vacation, but they can't get a break from one another.

episodes.name: The Three Fs
episodes.overview: Francine's newfound friendship with a frog brings excitement to the whole Smith household. Unfortunately, it drives their neighbor, Greg, crazy.

episodes.name: Smooshed: A Love Story
episodes.overview: Steve goes on a class trip to Philadelphia, where he hopes to fall in love.

episodes.name: The Fast and the Spurious
episodes.overview: Roger is forced to confront himself after a series of accidents. Klaus and Jeff bond.

episodes.name: A League of His Own
episodes.overview: Steve profiles Stan for an essay contest at school; Francine uses a porta john.

episodes.name: You Are Here
episodes.overview: Roger and Steve try to save a dying mall.

episodes.name: I Heard You Wanna Buy Some Speakers
episodes.overview: Barry blows out his dad's speakers and Snot helps him replace them. Stan attempts to do a standing backflip.

episodes.name: Hayley Was a Girl Scout?
episodes.overview: Stan is forced to co-lead a scouts troop with Hayley while Steve blunders in his fantasy world.

episodes.name: Please Please Jeff
episodes.overview: Jeff's people pleasing nature gets in the way of his relationship with Hayley; Stan wears a confusing costume to the CIA costume party.

episodes.name: Jambalaya
episodes.overview: When Francine successfully grows a garden, it reminds Roger he knows a recipe for truly authentic jambalaya.

episodes.name: Gernot and Strudel
episodes.overview: Hoping to teach him the value of sharing, the family recreates a television show from Klaus's childhood. Roger has a piano recital.

episodes.name: Echoes
episodes.overview: Steve starts a work-study program and discovers that not all is what it seems at Channel 3 News. Roger seeks redemption in the Nashville country music scene.

episodes.name: The Grounch
episodes.overview: When Roger has his famous Christmas sex party stolen from him the results are... monstrous. Stan creates a magazine for men.
